character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Create a cute, recognizable pixel-art ghost character for a colorful sci-fi puzzle adventure game called ECHO MAZE.  Character: A tiny spectral futuristic explorer, a ghostly traveler from a previous timeline.  Appearance:  * Compact humanoid explorer silhouette. * Small floating body. * Purple and lavender spectral suit. * Bright violet glowing energy core on the chest. * Pale lavender visor with expressive glowing eyes. * Small golden energy accents. * Subtle pixel-art energy particles surrounding the character. * Semi-transparent ghostly appearance.  Art style: Rich, colorful 16-bit-inspired pixel art, polished indie game aesthetic, carefully clustered pixels, crisp pixel edges, clean dark outlines.  View: Top-down 3/4 perspective, facing downward.  Composition: Single complete character, centered, full body visible, transparent background, no text, no UI, no additional characters.  The ghost should look like a playable game character, not a floating bedsheet ghost. Make it recognizable at small game sizes.
